verses.khitabi-lidhaka-l-awdha-iyyi-l-mumajjadi: khiṭābī lidhāka l-ʾawdhaʿʿiyī l-mumajjadi ʾabā ʿan khiṭābī sh-shisʿa qāṣida mashhadi
ʾarāhu ʿani l-ʾahlīna fī l-ʾamri nāʾiba kafā kulla dhī ṣadri salīmi t-tafaqqudi
yudārī dhawī l-ʾalbābi yadfaʿu zurʾahum yaqūduhumu lil-mahyaʿi l-mutafarridi
falaysa bimaghḍūbi ʿalayhi bisaʿyihi walaysa bimaqliyyi lifarṭi t-taballudi
huwa l-murtaḍā l-maḥbūbu la shakka ʾannahu fatā la yusāwā fī fakhāri wasuʾudadi
ʿafīfu ʾabiyyū l-buṭli nāfī balabili wajīhu ṣafiyyū l-wuddi lil-mutaqayyidi
famā ʾin ʾatā dhū fāqati yabtaghī n-nadā siwā ʾannahu yaḥwī munāhu bila dadi
falaw lam yakun thānī dhakāʾi lafātanā ḍiyāʾu yaʿʿumu l-quṭra fī kulli mawridi
walaw lam yakun thānī s-samāʾi bibadhlihi yaʿʿazu ʿalaynā mā ḥtawaynā mina l-yadi
ʾabā mā ʾabā r-raḥmānu rāḍiyā mā raḍī barīʾā mina fʿāli lʾahli t-tamarrudi
yuwāẓibu dhikra llāhi madḥa nabiyyihi yuʾawwilu ʾāyāti likulli muʾayyadi
yaqūmu ʾidhā mā nāmati n-nāsu nāsika ʿalā ḥālati turḍī ʾajalla l-muwaḥḥadi
laka l-ʿizzu min dhī l-ʿizzati l-fardi was-sanā yazīnuka fī ẓilli ʾatayta wamarṣadi
kaʾan lam yakun ʾila madīḥaka qawlatu liman wudduhum fī llāhi ghayru muṭarradi
famā ḥuzta min faḍli yuʿʿasiru ḥaṣruhu wamā nilta min majdi ʿawīṣu t-taʿʿadudi
raqayta maqāmā la tuqārabu rifʿaha wabaʿdu raqayta d-dāʾa ḥilfa t-tajaddudi
faʾayyū mruʾi yarqā fayarqā mukhaṣṣiṣā biʾuʿjūbatay rabbi l-warā l-mutuwaḥḥidi
khala laka hadhā d-dahru ʿan kulli mushbihi likawnika taḥwī sh-shukra min khayri murshidi
ʾabī bakri s-sāmī tabayyana maznuhu ʿalayka wahadhā l-maznu ʿaynu t-tafarrudi
faʾin taku la takhlū ʾabā manṣu min hudā yufarriju ʾaqwāmā wamin ghayri maḥtadi
faʾinniyā la ʾakhlū mini rʿafi mizbari yakillu dhawī l-ʾinshāʾā bisharwāhu fī n-nadī
ʿalā l-muṣṭafā l-mabʿūthi wal-ʾāli ṣaḥbihi salamā ʾilahi l-ʿālamīna wamuqtadi
